name: std::pmr::memory_resource::do_allocate
intro:
Allocates storage with a size of at least bytes bytes, aligned to the specified alignment.

alignment shall be a power of two.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: Throws an exception if storage of the requested size and alignment cannot be obtained.

summary: Allocates storage with a size of at least bytes bytes, aligned to the specified alignment.
